nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-hermes package, describing how Hermes AI agent lifecycle hooks (on_session_start, pre_llm_call, post_llm_call) are wired into hive-mind frames for silent conversation capture, including install/uninstall instructions, capture fidelity table, and headless consent caveats.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for @waggle/hive-mind-hooks-hermes v0.1.0, declaring the Hermes silent-capture shim with ESM exports for three hook entry points (session-start, user-prompt-submit, stop), a CLI binary, and dependencies on hive-mind-hooks-core and hive-mind-shim-core.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM-only module (type: module) with three named hook exports and a bin entry for the hermes-hooks CLI. Peer-depends on @waggle/hive-mind-cli (optional).

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript build configuration for the hive-mind-hooks-hermes package, extending the monorepo base config with composite project references to hive-mind-hooks-core and hive-mind-shim-core, and compiling src to dist.

nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for test files in hive-mind-hooks-hermes, extending the base monorepo config with noEmit mode, covering both src and tests directories without emitting declarations or source maps.
